instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Waste-to-energy facility processing 180,000 tons of municipal solid waste annually, generating 15 MW of baseload electricity. The company is currently focused on optimizing high-temperature combustion processes and exploring advanced carbon capture technologies to meet future environmental compliance needs. Operations are primarily localized, focusing intensely on maximizing energy recovery from feedstock.
answers.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources. Our current portfolio includes 4 active projects across new business models, digital products, and operational AI use cases. One incubated project has already graduated to become a standalone business unit.
answers.strategicGoals: We are targeting a 20% improvement in operational throughput without increasing headcount. Our processes have grown organically over the years and are overdue for standardization. We suspect that workflow digitization, basic automation, and better data integration between our core systems can unlock significant productivity gains within our current cost structure.
answers.additionalContext: We completed a merger with a similarly-sized competitor 4 months ago and are in the middle of integrating teams, systems, and processes. The combined organization has significant duplication — two CRMs, two HR systems, overlapping product lines. There is a unique window to redesign processes from scratch rather than patching legacy approaches, but cultural integration is fragile and change fatigue is real.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Predictive Maintenance AI for Boiler Optimization
opportunities.rationale: Implement basic machine learning models on operational data to predict equipment failure in the district heating network or boiler systems. This incremental step directly addresses the 'efficiency' priority by minimizing unplanned downtime and optimizing fuel usage immediately.

first_actions: Identify a subset of historical sensor data (boiler temperatures, pressure logs).
Pilot a low-cost monitoring dashboard using existing IT infrastructure.
resources_needed: Senior consultant for basic ML model training.
Software licensing for basic time-series analysis tools ($5k).
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce unplanned downtime by 10% within 6 months.
milestones: M2: Predictive alert system running on pilot assets (Month 3).
M3: Full operational integration into maintenance schedule (Month 5).

opportunities.title: Modular, Decentralized Energy Harvesting Integration
opportunities.rationale: Explore the radical concept of integrating small-scale, localized microgrids directly into the waste processing plant to create self-sustaining energy loops. This bypasses traditional grid reliance and significantly increases operational resilience and efficiency in a low regulatory environment.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on solar/wind integration for ancillary power generation.
Identify specific equipment (e.g., battery storage) suitable for existing plant footprint.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 15% reduction in purchased energy costs within the pilot zone.
milestones: M1: Detailed site assessment and technology selection (Month 2).
M3: Full integration into operational efficiency report (Month 9).

opportunities.title: Standardized Data Integration Platform Implementation
opportunities.rationale: Address the integration bottleneck identified during the merger by selecting and implementing a standardized ERP/CRM stack. This is crucial for unlocking significant productivity gains by providing real-time visibility into operational metrics, supporting throughput goals.

first_actions: Select three top vendor options for system consolidation.
Establish a cross-functional team to map core data flows.
resources_needed: Annual licensing fees and implementation consultant costs ($75k).
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 98% data accuracy across core operational KPIs.
milestones: M2: Core system integration phase begins (Month 4-6).
M3: Full rollout and training complete (Month 9).

next_steps.action: Initiate the predictive maintenance pilot project using existing operational data.
Form a dedicated task force to evaluate modular energy harvesting technologies and define scope for radical opportunity assessment.

key_weaknesses: Extreme dependency on single decision-maker (founder) leading to potential bottleneck and limited technical bandwidth.
Fragile organizational culture due to recent merger, resulting in significant process duplication (two CRMs, two HR systems).
Low digital maturity (Level 3), hindering the ability to leverage data for proactive efficiency gains.
Lack of specialized internal engineering expertise required for complex technology evaluation and rapid prototyping.
